# Daily Briefing – Friday 10 July

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training logged and just 4,861 steps, though your calories burned (2,337 kcal) almost perfectly matched your 2,300 target, which is solid. The main concern is that 4.9 hours of sleep — that's genuinely not enough, and your body will be feeling it.

Your HRV at 91ms is sitting below your 102–119ms baseline, which alongside the short sleep is a clear signal your nervous system is under-recovered. Stress at 41/100 is manageable, and your resting HR of 50 bpm looks healthy — but the HRV dip means today should be easy: a gentle walk or light mobility work only. Don't fight the data.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else — aim for 8 hours minimum. Poor sleep blunts protein synthesis, so hitting your 175g protein target today matters even more for recovery.
